Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

r4subrepro 0.4.1

  • Add a pkgdown documentation site and prepare metadata for CRAN submission.

r4subrepro 0.4.0

  • Adds assess_compiled_toolchain() (R-REPRO-012), which detects whether the submission compiles native code (C/C++/Fortran source, a src/ folder, a Makevars script, or an inline sourceCpp()/cppFunction()/R CMD SHLIB call) and, when it does, checks that the Rtools toolchain reviewers need to build it on Windows is documented. CRAN packages install as prebuilt Windows binaries, so a submission without local compilation passes.
  • assess_proprietary_pkgs() (R-REPRO-005) now tiers referenced packages by how reproducible their source is instead of a binary known/unknown split: CRAN or known packages pass, non-CRAN packages declared from a GitHub/Git/URL/ local source warn (bundle the sources), and undeclared proprietary packages warn at medium severity. Renamed to “Package Reproducibility Tiering”.
  • assess_output_reproduction() (R-REPRO-008) now separates analytical content from cosmetic bytes: data outputs must match exactly, but rtf and pdf outputs are compared after their embedded generation timestamps are stripped, so an output that differs only in generation time counts as reproduced rather than a false mismatch.
  • Reweights the indicator set to include the compiled-code toolchain check.

r4subrepro 0.3.0

  • Adds assess_windows_reviewability() (R-REPRO-011), a static check for non-portable constructs that can break on a Windows reviewer machine (shell-outs, forking, POSIX paths). Windows is the FDA reviewer environment.
  • assess_output_reproduction() (R-REPRO-008) now records the operating system the re-run happened on and warns when it is not Windows, since the outputs must reproduce on the reviewer’s Windows machine.
  • Reweights the indicator set to include Windows reviewability.
  • assess_env_lockfile() (R-REPRO-001) now grades lockfile quality instead of mere presence: a version-pinned renv.lock or packrat lockfile passes, an renv.lock stub with no versions or a DESCRIPTION-only dependency list warns, and nothing fails. A top-level dependency list is not a version-pinned lockfile.
  • adrg_skeleton() now generates an Executive Summary (overview of the analysis programs and their purpose), a Troubleshooting section (path, package install, Rtools/compiled, R-version, and proprietary-package failure modes), and an analysis-type (primary/secondary) column in the program table. assess_adrg() requires the executive summary and troubleshooting sections.

r4subrepro 0.2.0

  • Adds assess_output_reproduction() (R-REPRO-008), which re-runs a submission’s entry point in a fresh, sandboxed R session and checks that the outputs match the submitted outputs byte for byte. Execution is opt-in and never touches the submission folder; without run = TRUE the indicator returns na.
  • assess_reproducibility() gains include_execution to append the output-reproduction check.
  • Adds assess_dual_verification() (R-REPRO-009), which checks that the submission declares independent verification of its results, such as an SAS versus R comparison or a QC report, and assess_sas_r_concordance(), which compares two result tables cell by cell within a tolerance. The static check is included in assess_reproducibility().
  • Adds assess_adrg() (R-REPRO-010), which checks that the submission includes an Analysis Data Reviewer’s Guide covering the required inputs, run order, expected outputs, R packages, and environment setup, and adrg_skeleton(), which generates a draft in the standard PHUSE / R Consortium ADRG structure (sections 1 to 8 plus an R execution appendix), auto-filling the analysis datasets, the analysis output programs and a program-to-output traceability table, the proprietary and open-source R package split with versions, and the execution steps, and adding a Reproducibility and Verification section the base template omits. The check is included in assess_reproducibility().
  • Reweights the indicator set to accommodate the new reproducibility, verification, and reviewer-guide indicators.

r4subrepro 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Adds seven static reproducibility and reviewability indicators over a submission’s analysis code folder, following the guidance on making R submissions reviewable for regulators: environment lockfile present (R-REPRO-001), path hygiene (R-REPRO-002), single entry point (R-REPRO-003), hidden setup assumptions (R-REPRO-004), proprietary package declaration (R-REPRO-005), clean run evidence (R-REPRO-006), and script complexity (R-REPRO-007).
  • assess_reproducibility() runs all seven and returns a combined R4SUB evidence table with indicator_domain = "usability", so the results flow into the Submission Confidence Index.
  • reproducibility_summary() gives a weighted overall score with a readable print method.
